title: Solvia Visual Identity
summary: A clean-energy brand that feels as warm as sunlight and as smart as the technology behind it.

heroMedia.alt: Upload: Solvia key visual, wordmark over a solar sunset (16:9)

cardMedia.alt: Upload: Solvia cover for the project card (4:5)

challenge: Solvia builds smart solar systems for homes and small businesses, with AI energy management and connected devices. The brand had to show real innovation without feeling cold, and sophistication without losing its human touch — an energy company people trust and actually want to live with.
approach: We built the idea around intelligent, flowing energy: a system that adapts and responds to the people it serves. Fluid shapes and warm gradients stand for motion, efficiency and the natural warmth of the sun, held together by precise geometry that signals smart technology.
solution: A unified identity of precise geometry, organic gradients and a human-centred design language. The mark follows the rhythm of solar energy — its cycles, warmth and constant motion — while the wider system keeps every touchpoint clear and open, from print to the app.
results: A cohesive, future-facing identity that positions Solvia as a leader in smart, sustainable energy, and that stays consistent across print and digital as the company grows.

sections.heading: Smart energy, eco innovation, future living
sections.body: Three ideas carry the brand. Every visual choice is tested against them: does it feel intelligent, does it feel clean, and does it feel like a better way to live?

media.alt: Upload: brand pillars over solar panels (16:9)

sections.heading: A mark that moves like sunlight
sections.body: We explored dozens of solar forms before settling on a mark built from rays in rotation — a sun that is always turning, always producing, never static.
